audit.concept_type: brochure + enquiry: the studios, what is on site, getting here, the published specials matched to your dates, a dates enquiry by email and the real BahamaGo booking link
must_keep: Book Now link to the BahamaGo engine
the published Out Islands specials with their booking and blackout dates
flight and airport facts from the FAQ
weaknesses: One long page of #!/ anchors: Google sees one page and nobody can link to the rooms or the flights
Headline is Welcome to Orange Creek Inn; the beach across the road is buried in FAQ 20
Six specials rotate in a slider of small print; a guest cannot tell which fit their dates
Flight times, taxi fare and car rental prices sit at the bottom of 27 FAQs
No rates and no room description beyond an amenity icon list
Photos are 900 px wide and shown as 520 px square crops
audit.note: Refreshed in 2026 by a hotel marketing vendor but still a template one-pager; small family inn (the Cleares per guest reviews on their own site).
